headline: Fire erupts in Banani high-rise, flames spotted on 23rd floor
summary: Two Fire Service units are working to bring the blaze under control in a 26-storey building beside the FR Tower.
details: A fire broke out in a high-rise building in Dhaka’s Banani area on Saturday evening.
The Fire Service and Civil Defence received a report at 5:36 pm, with flames being spotted on the 23rd floor of a 26-storey building.
Two units from the Fire Service have been deployed to the scene to bring the blaze under control.
Authorities have not yet provided details regarding the cause of the fire or the extent of the damage.
The building is located beside the FR Tower, which was the site of a devastating blaze in 2019 that killed 26 people and injured around 70 others.

headline_marked: Virat Kohli says [[2027 World Cup will be his last]] for India
headline: Virat Kohli says 2027 World Cup will be his last for India
summary: The 37-year-old batter, who has scored 14,941 ODI runs, is determined to give his all to help India lift the trophy in his final campaign.
details: Virat Kohli has announced that the 2027 50-overs World Cup will be his final tournament for India. He stated his motivation is to leave everything on the field and win the trophy.
